rationale: The candidate reads as a low, layered bar in the isometric and opposite views, but the intended continuous torqued ribbon is not legible across all four views. The front view is especially flat and fragmented, while the top view exposes several crossing planes and ambiguous overlaps rather than a controlled bend. The massing relies heavily on thin terrace-like layers, has weak primary/support hierarchy, and does not establish a meaningful public void or undercut. Its relationship to the references is limited to a generic stacked-terrace signal.
warnings: The dominant gesture is not coherent across all views.
Top-view geometry shows apparent plane crossings or solid collisions.
The form reads more as clipped surface layers than as one continuous primary mass.
No clear courtyard, undercut, or open-ground void is established.
